provenance: Author-reported aggregate; no per-frame records supplied.
collection: Several clips recorded while the hand rotates the cube
cameras: Three Intel RealSense D405: one test camera, two reference cameras
reference: FoundationPose on the two reference cameras, transformed to the test-camera frame with calibrated extrinsics; frames on which the two references differ by more than 5 mm or 5 degrees are discarded; remaining poses averaged (quaternion average for rotation)
criterion: translation error < 10 mm and rotation error < 10 degrees relative to the reference
baseline: ViserDex-style RGB keypoint estimator trained from the same source as ours
